title: Deterministic generated artifact bytes
statement: For identical blueprint bytes, options, and generator version, module generation MUST emit byte-identical relative files and a digest manifest; check mode MUST detect missing, extra, or changed files without writing.
rationale: Stable outputs and an honest read-only check allow the generated result to be reviewed and reproduced.

strategy.rationale: Generator unit tests compare independent output trees byte for byte and probe every check-mode drift state; packed-consumer tests verify manifest digests and read-only check behavior.
